user.title: Basic Configuration
user.description:
STATS calculates daily energy values from live power sensors. Separate daily kWh sensors are not required.

The current household power sensor is required.

data_description.country: Select your country for VAT and electricity price defaults.
data_description.sensor_home_consumption: Unit: W. Current total power demand of the household. STATS calculates the energy used since midnight from this sensor. (Required)

energy_flows.title: Energy Flows
energy_flows.description: Select the available live power sensors. STATS calculates the corresponding kWh values from midnight automatically. All fields are optional.

data_description.sensor_solar_to_house: Direct solar power supplied to the household. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_inverter_ac_output: Total AC power produced by the inverter. Do not select the PV DC input or the smart meter grid-export sensor. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_battery_to_house: Battery power supplied to the household. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_grid_to_house: Grid power supplied directly to the household. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_house_to_grid: Power exported from the house to the grid. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_smartmeter_import: Current import measured by the smart meter. Used when no separate Grid to House sensor is available. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_smartmeter_export: Current export measured by the smart meter. Used when no separate House to Grid sensor is available. (Optional)

optional.title: Battery and Additional Data
optional.description: Configure these fields only when the corresponding values are available. Systems without a battery can skip this step.

data_description.sensor_battery_soc: Unit: Percent (0-100). Current state of charge. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_battery_power: Unit: Watt. Positive = charging, Negative = discharging. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_grid_import_extra: Special fallback only: additional grid energy not captured by the configured power sensors. Must report the value since midnight in kWh. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_price_total: Current total electricity price including fees and taxes. Required only when provided by another integration. (Optional)

consumers.title: Consumers
consumers.description: Configure live power sensors for additional consumers. STATS calculates their daily energy automatically. All fields are optional.

data_description.sensor_heatpump_power: Current electrical power input of the heat pump. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_heatingrod_power: Current electrical power input of the heating rod. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_wallbox_power: Current charging power of the wallbox. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_wallbox_state: Current wallbox state, such as charging, connected or idle. (Optional)

consumer_details.title: Consumer Details
consumer_details.description: Additional values for the heat pump and wallbox detail views. These fields are optional and can be skipped.

data.sensor_hp_dhw_charging: Heat Pump: Hot Water Charging Active
data.sensor_hp_electric_power: Heat Pump: Electrical Power (W or kW)
data.sensor_hp_thermal_power: Heat Pump: Thermal Power (W or kW)
data.sensor_hp_storage_temp: Heat Pump: Hot Water Storage Temperature

data_description.sensor_hp_heating_mode: Select entity containing the current heating mode. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_dhw_mode: Select entity containing the hot water mode. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_dhw_charging: Binary sensor indicating active hot water preparation. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_pv_active: Binary sensor indicating the heat pump's PV mode. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_electric_power: Current electrical input used for the heat pump detail view. The main heat pump power sensor may be selected again. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_thermal_power: Current thermal output of the heat pump. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_grid_daily: Grid energy used by the heat pump since midnight. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_pv_daily: PV energy used by the heat pump since midnight. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_hp_jaz: Current COP or annual performance factor. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_wb_charge_mode: Select entity containing the current charging mode. (Optional)
data_description.sensor_wb_energy_session: Energy charged during the current session. (Optional)

smart_charging.title: Smart Charging
smart_charging.description: Automatic battery charging from grid during cheap hours, respecting solar forecast and average daily consumption. Target SOC is calculated dynamically to leave enough room for tomorrow's solar surplus, clamped to min/max.

data_description.smart_charging_enabled: Master toggle. When off, no charging logic runs.
data_description.battery_capacity: Usable battery capacity. Used to translate solar kWh forecast into SOC percent.
data_description.min_soc: Target SOC will never fall below this value.
data_description.max_soc: Target SOC will never exceed this value. Typical: 95-100.
data_description.max_price: Current price below this threshold is considered cheap. Only then grid charging is allowed.
data_description.force_charge_price: Current price below this threshold triggers forced grid charging to max_soc during solar deficits (daytime) or at night.
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: Battery State-of-Charge sensor (0-100%). Without it, logic falls back to price-only mode.
data_description.smart_charging_switch: Switch entity to turn grid charging on/off in Home Assistant.
data_description.sensor_price_total: Monetary sensor providing current dynamic price (e.g. from Tibber).

data_description.billing_price_mode: Dynamic: hourly prices from GPM. Fixed: single price. None: disables financial displays.

data_description.amortization_annual_running_costs_eur: Maintenance, insurance, metering or similar yearly costs.
data_description.amortization_price_increase_percent: Assumption for rising electricity prices in the projection.
data_description.amortization_degradation_percent: Annual PV output degradation in the projection.
